# Overseas Tyre And Services Sdn Bhd

> Overseas Tyre And Services Sdn Bhd (Pusat Servis Kereta Dan Tayar) is a Michelin dealer and car workshop in Taman Bukit Indah, Johor Bahru, Malaysia.

- Address: 2, Jalan Indah 16/11, Taman Bukit Indah, 81200 Johor Bahru, Johor Darul Ta'zim, Malaysia
- WhatsApp: +60 18-234 1322 (https://wa.me/60182341322)
- In-Charge Manager: +60 10-462 4633
- Workshop line: +60 7-231 5364
- Email: overseastyrebi@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday 9:30am to 7:30pm; closed on Wednesdays
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/OVERSEAS+TYRE+AND+SERVICES+SDN+BHD/@1.480535,103.6639989,17z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x31da733466bf49fd:0xe9fe33867e85ed0f!8m2!3d1.480535!4d103.6639989!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F11bw2j0j5t
- Michelin dealer locator: https://www.michelin.com.my/auto/dealer-locator/johor-bahru/yzlrewv-overseas-tyre-and-services
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/Overseas-Tyre-And-Services/61564844053517/
- Languages: English, Bahasa Melayu, 简体中文

## Services
- Tyres: Michelin dealer. Supply, fitting, repair and replacement. https://autoseo.my/preview/overseas-tyre/services/tyres/
- Wheel alignment and balancing: Straight steering and smooth wheels. https://autoseo.my/preview/overseas-tyre/services/wheel-alignment/
- Car servicing: Engine oil, lubricants and regular maintenance. https://autoseo.my/preview/overseas-tyre/services/car-servicing/
- Brakes and suspension: Brakes, shock absorbers, suspension and spare parts. https://autoseo.my/preview/overseas-tyre/services/brakes-suspension/
- Battery and aircon: Car battery replacement and air-conditioning service. https://autoseo.my/preview/overseas-tyre/services/battery-aircond/
- Diagnostics: Troubleshooting with clear explanations. https://autoseo.my/preview/overseas-tyre/services/diagnostics/
